description: Election Commission -  Declare that  S. M. P. Lalith Kumbara as a member of the Meerigama P/S
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Mirigama Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the resignation of a member, nomination by a political party, and declaration of a new member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as defined in Type 7, which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
